candidates.name: OGC API - Features - Part 1: Core corrigendum
verified_facts: Defines landing, conformance, collections and /collections/{collectionId}/items feature-query resources.
Core query access is feature-level and its default geometry CRS is WGS 84 longitude/latitude.
Discovery of collections and feature items is API access semantics, not numeric elevation evidence.
semantic_limits: Feature API conformance does not identify the EA contributing LiDAR survey or validate a terrain range value.

candidates.name: OGC API - Features - Part 2: Coordinate Reference Systems by Reference corrigendum
verified_facts: Adds advertised supported CRS identifiers and bbox-crs/crs request parameters to OGC API Features.
When bbox-crs is supplied the server performs the transformations needed to fetch matching data.
Response geometry may be requested in a supported CRS different from the default.
semantic_limits: CRS transformation is query/representation processing and must not be mistaken for native raster sampling or a vertical-accuracy improvement.

candidates.name: OGC API - Features - Part 3: Filtering
verified_facts: Defines Queryables resources and filter/filter-lang/filter-crs parameters for feature collections.
Queryables enumerate properties that can be used to construct filter expressions.
Filtering is evaluated per feature and can be combined with bbox and datetime predicates.
semantic_limits: Filtering selects metadata-index features; it does not prove that a selected feature is the composite contributor until attribute and spatial/temporal matching criteria are satisfied.

candidates.name: Common Query Language (CQL2)
verified_facts: Defines CQL2 Text and CQL2 JSON filter-expression encodings.
Supports comparison, spatial and temporal predicates through conformance classes.
CQL2 is designed to be used by API filtering endpoints such as OGC API Features Part 3.
semantic_limits: A syntactically valid CQL2 query does not certify source authority, survey identity, or elevation accuracy.

candidates.name: OGC API - Common - Part 1: Core
verified_facts: Defines reusable HTTP, URI, landing-page, API-definition and conformance building blocks for OGC Web APIs.
Implemented conformance classes are advertised through the /conformance resource.
Conformance discovery is necessary before relying on optional API capabilities.
semantic_limits: API conformance advertisement is capability evidence only and is not parcel-specific terrain provenance or numeric validation.
